$comment: Single source of truth for Sabicars colour. Generates tokens.css (npm run tokens) and is validated by scripts/check-contrast.mjs, which fails the build on any illegible pair. Edit here, never in CSS.

green.$comment: Sabi Green — the signature and the colour of trust: the logo's 'Sabi', labels, links, Verified, success. 500 is the logo colour, kept exact (#78B030, nearest Pantone 368 C). Built in OKLCH so each step is an even perceptual stride. On dark, text uses 300; on light, 700 and darker.

orange.$comment: Sabi Orange — the action, and only the action: the button you should press. 500 is the logo colour, kept exact (#F7801E, nearest Pantone 1495 C). A screen with orange in more than one or two places has lost its call to action.

darkSurface.$comment: Night: near-black with a whisper of green, so the dark reads as material and belongs with the brand rather than as dead grey. Each rung is the smallest OKLCH step that clears 1.15 against the one below (2026-10-20).

darkText.$comment: Bone, not white: a warm-neutral that is easy on the eye on Night at 17:1.

focus.$comment: A dedicated token, never a border colour. Must clear 3:1 on every surface it can land on.

ink.$comment: Light-theme call to action: a Night button with a white label. Orange text on white fails at body sizes.
